newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-FRENCH GRAND PRIX DEADLINE EXTENDED.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-FRENCH GRAND PRIX DEADLINE EXTENDED.

text.p: French Grand Prix organisers have been given another three months to resolve a dispute over local television rights ahead of the June 29 race at Magny Cours. But the International Automobile Federation (FIA) said on Friday that race organisers were optimistic that the problem would be settled.
The French round of the world championship was originally included in the 1997 calendar announced in December on condition that the organisers had everything in place by the end of January.
The FIA said the season-ending Portuguese Grand Prix was confirmed for Estoril on October 26, subject to a circuit inspection at the end of August.
